prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1156; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. The patient reported neck pain, stiffness, and headaches beginning shortly after the incident, with restricted cervical range of motion on initial examination. Clinical findings were consistent with a whiplash-associated cervical strain without neurological deficit.

Treatment over the course of care included twelve visits consisting of manual therapy, targeted cervical mobilization, therapeutic exercise for postural and range-of-motion deficits, and home exercise instruction. Pain was managed with conservative measures, and the patient was advised on activity modification during the acute phase.

Progress was gradual. By the later visits, the patient demonstrated improved cervical range of motion, reduced headache frequency, and better tolerance for daily activities and work duties. Residual mild stiffness with prolonged sitting was noted at the most recent evaluation.

The patient was discharged to an independent home exercise program with instructions to return if symptoms worsen or fail to resolve. Prognosis is fair to good, with full recovery anticipated within a reasonable timeframe given adherence to the home program.
